aerial-a.defect: Aircraft pops out of the reference composition between still and flight capture.
aerial-a.fix: Keep the aircraft inside the fixed frame during the flight capture or fix the culling/LOD that removes it.

aerial-a.defect: Wakes are line decals without boats.
aerial-a.fix: Attach wakes to boat meshes, render V-shaped Kelvin pattern with decaying foam texture.
Add shadow cascades reaching at least 3 km with soft filtering.

aerial-a.defect: Repetition visible in vegetation, clouds and buildings at first glance.
aerial-a.fix: Introduce per-instance scale/hue variation and multiple source models.
Add screen-space or planar reflections blended by Fresnel; at minimum reflect the sky/cloud environment map.

aerial-a.defect: Wakes are chalk lines; surf reads as noise marbling.
aerial-a.fix: Use a fading V-wake with Kelvin angle and turbulence texture; replace swirl noise with shore-aligned surf lines.

aerial-a.defect: Clone ball trees with obvious repetition.
aerial-a.fix: Use 6-8 palm/broadleaf variants with random scale/rotation and lighter, more varied foliage tones.
Enable cascaded shadow maps for vegetation and buildings.
Add GGX specular on water with sun glitter and clear-coat on the aircraft.
Randomise tree variants and cloud shapes.

aerial-a.defect: Wing reads as a paper-thin plate; floats as capsules without step or chine.
aerial-a.fix: Give the wing a real airfoil section (12-15% thickness) and model float step, chine and spreader bars.

aerial-a.defect: Glass has no reflection or highlight from a sun that lights the wing to 240.
aerial-a.fix: Give glass a Fresnel reflection of sky/sun with a sharp highlight.

bridge-low.defect: Water ignores the objects in it.
Deck reads as floating; supports miss the water.
bridge-low.fix: Model pier columns to the waterline with foam collars and a deck shadow; add cable anchorages.

bridge-low.defect: Shadows are missing in the near field.
bridge-low.fix: Enable shadow maps for aircraft and bridge.

bridge-low.defect: Thin plate wing and struts piercing floats.
bridge-low.fix: Airfoil thickness and modelled strut fittings.

bridge-low.defect: Skyline lacks variation and façade detail.
Coastlines are hard-edged with no surf or shoal gradient.
bridge-low.fix: Add shoal gradient and surf line.

bridge-low.defect: Reflections missing for large white structures adjacent to the water.
bridge-low.fix: Planar reflection for the bridge and sky.

bridge-low.defect: No individual trees at this distance.

cloudy.fix: Replace with shoreline-following foam from a distance field.
Drive sun intensity/softness from cloud cover.

cloudy.defect: uniform foam rings (hard failure); HEAD 42d764ba gates surf to beds that reach land.
cloudy.fix: compute shoreDist from the zone distance-to-coast channel or a shore SDF and require the depth gradient to point at the coastline before drawing surf.

cloudy.defect: hard-failure ring foam plus visible aliasing.

462 calls / 1.75 M tris both over budget; vegetation 3D crowns (157 calls / 484k) and city (86 / 284k) on top of the constant road/bridge base; the clip is the slowest of the round (median 16.9 ms) because the overcast raymarch shades the whole sky every frame.
cloudy.fix: vegetation LOD distances, road/bridge chunking, cheaper overcast raymarch (adaptive steps).

cockpit-city.defect: Uniform roughness/albedo across the whole interior object.
cockpit-city.fix: Texture the interior with painted-metal roughness variation, screws and scuffs.

cockpit-city.defect: Paper-thin wing geometry visible in ordinary play.
cockpit-city.fix: Add a true airfoil section with a visible rounded leading edge and thickness.

cockpit-city.defect: Uniform roughness/albedo across the whole wing surface.
cockpit-city.fix: Add rib/stringer normal detail, root AO and a roughness map with variation.

cockpit-city.defect: Glass is invisible and the prop disc is a flat grey arc.
cockpit-city.fix: Add subtle Fresnel reflection of the panel, and render the prop disc as a motion-blurred rotating blade.
Populate boats with wakes near the shore.
Enable shadow casting from the wing/frame into the cockpit.

cockpit-city.defect: Specular response missing on all interior materials.
cockpit-city.fix: Give gauges glass Fresnel and bezels a metallic response.

cockpit-city.defect: worst view of the round: 464 calls (+16%) and 2.32 M tris (+54%) over budget; 3D vegetation crowns within the 650 m NEAR_DISTANCE over the residential island are 866k tris of the frame, then shadows 458k and the unculled road mesh 246k.
cockpit-city.fix: cut vegetation NEAR_DISTANCE/NEAR_BUDGET (HEAD 6c65e5bd: 200 m subdivided / 420 m cards), chunk roads, cull bridges/traffic from cascades they do not intersect.
Rebuild cowl and posts with fillets and proper attachment fairings.
Enable shadow casting for cockpit geometry.

glass-sun.fix: Fresnel glass with sun highlight; modelled pilot and seats.

glass-sun.defect: Missing reflection of the aircraft on the water it sits on (hard failure: wrong reflections).
glass-sun.fix: Add a planar reflection pass for fixed cameras blended by Fresnel.

glass-sun.defect: Glass with zero reflection under a direct 15:30 sun in the view built to test it (hard failure: wrong reflections on glass).
glass-sun.fix: Add a Fresnel-weighted environment and sun reflection to the glass shader and replace the interior blocks with a textured panel, seats and pilot.

glass-sun.defect: Floats hover above straight white wake bands (hard failure: floating geometry).
glass-sun.fix: Lower the resting waterline so the keel is immersed, add bow waves and a buoyancy solver with wave response.

glass-sun.defect: Specular response missing on paint, glass and water in direct sun.
glass-sun.fix: GGX clear-coat, glass Fresnel and a sun glitter term.

glass-sun.defect: Glass reads as an empty hole; placeholder interior.

island-pass.defect: Hard depth step and visible tiling in the ocean.
island-pass.fix: Smooth depth-based absorption and break texture tiling with a second rotated layer.

night.defect: Missing reflections of emissive city lights.

night.defect: Missing reflections of the only light sources in the scene (hard failure: wrong reflections).

night.defect: cloud lighting ignores the night state (sun below horizon still lights clouds) and stars appear at blue-hour brightness.
night.fix: scale cloud sun irradiance by the atmosphere night factor and fade stars with sky brightness.
